guides.title: 多模干涉分光器：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Multimode-interference splitters: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: MMI 自成像不是任意長度都能成立。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: MMI self-imaging requires suitable geometry. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：MMI 自成像不是任意長度都能成立。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較分光比、相位與波長漂移。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.
Mark this question on your own diagram: MMI self-imaging requires suitable geometry. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare splitting ratio, phase and wavelength dependence. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較分光比、相位與波長漂移」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare splitting ratio, phase and wavelength dependence, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 多模干涉分光器：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.concept: 先用「建立模態疊加：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。多模區內不同傳播常數累積相位差，在特定長度重建一個或多個像。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Build a modal superposition: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Modes with different propagation constants accumulate phase differences and recreate one or more images at selected lengths. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜建立模態疊加：模型與設計：畫至少三個模態的相位演進，檢查輸出位置。
觀察站 2｜量測不平衡：模型與設計：同時畫總傳輸與兩路比值，解讀 0.193 dB 範例。
觀察站 3｜驗證電路層重建：量測與判別：重建 MMI 頻譜並比對兩輸出複數響應及延遲。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Build a modal superposition: model and design: Plot phase evolution of at least three modes and inspect image positions.
Observation station 2 | Measure imbalance: model and design: Plot total transmission and output ratio together and interpret the 0.193 dB example.
Observation station 3 | Verify circuit-level reconstruction: measurement and diagnosis: Reconstruct spectra and compare complex outputs and delay.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「量測不平衡：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「驗證電路層重建：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Measure imbalance: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Verify circuit-level reconstruction: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「MMI 就是把光當水平均分岔」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「平衡良好就代表損耗低」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "An MMI simply splits light like a fluid junction" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "Good balance implies low loss" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.summary: 以公開光子研發與封裝機構為地理代表，討論多模自成像、分光平衡與複數 S 參數如何由單一元件走向可量測、可封裝的系統。地圖沿用本學院矽光子課程的代表據點，並非此技術唯一發源地或所有文獻實驗位置。
courses.summaryEn: A public photonic research/packaging institution provides geographic context for translating Multimode self-imaging, split balance and complex S-parameters from a component into a measurable packaged system. The map uses the academy’s silicon-photonics reference location, not the sole invention site or every cited laboratory.

history.title: 從元件演示到可重現介面
history.titleEn: From component demonstration to reproducible interfaces
history.text: 公開研究與模擬教學逐步把多模自成像、分光平衡與複數 S 參數連到基準、容差與封裝驗證。本課沿此方法脈絡安排作業，不宣稱單一機構獨創整項技術。
history.textEn: Public research and simulation tutorials connect Multimode self-imaging, split balance and complex S-parameters to reference conditions, tolerances and package validation. The course follows that methodological progression without assigning invention to one institution.

history.title: 跨元件與封裝的共同驗證
history.text: 相同光學性能需在固定、溫變與電性連接之後重新檢查；原始研究結果與量產資格是不同證據層級。
history.textEn: Recheck optical behavior after attachment, temperature change and electrical connection; research results and production qualification are different evidence levels.
